attributes.name: Contractor Onboarding
attributes.description: Onboarding for a contractor starting an engagement: paperwork, access, scope and kickoff.

tasks.title: Contract & paperwork setup
tasks.description: Countersigned contract, NDA and invoicing details on file
tasks.notes: Check the VAT id before the first invoice

tasks.title: Equipment & access provisioning
tasks.description: VPN, tools and the project channels the engagement needs
tasks.notes: Access ends with the contract; set the expiry now

tasks.title: Team introduction & scope review
tasks.description: Meet the team and agree the scope of the first deliverable
tasks.notes: Write the agreed scope into the project card

tasks.title: Project kickoff
tasks.description: First working session on the engagement
